import re, pathlib, subprocess
files=[p for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py') if '.git' not in p.parts]
for p in files:
    s=p.read_text()
    if 'legacy_fetch' not in s or p.as_posix()=='svc/api.py': continue
    n=s.replace('legacy_fetch(','fetch_v2(')
    n=re.sub(r'^(from svc\.api import .*)\blegacy_fetch\b', r'\1fetch_v2', n, flags=re.M)
    p.write_text(n); print(p)
print(subprocess.run(['grep','-rn','legacy_fetch','--include=*.py','.'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
